forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: A read of a board with no log shows the default columns
+---
+SWE-bench kanban24 (django__django-14997, root seq 21478): `{ board { name columns { id name } } }` on a repo with no `.kanban/` gave `columns: []`, so the model added an `in-progress` column before its first addTask (seq 21496). The first mutation already auto-inits todo/doing/review/done, but the in-memory display board (`Graph.withBoard(named:at:)` in Tool/Commit.swift) had no columns, so a read did not match what the first write makes.
+
+Fix: the in-memory empty board also gets `DefaultColumn.all`. No file is written.
+
+Tests (BoardMutationTests): a query in an empty repo shows the 4 default columns and writes no file; the first addTask to `todo` in an empty repo lands in To Do. #bug
\ No newline at end of file
